cat <<'ANTRIEB_ARCHIVE_BACKEND' | sudo -n tee /usr/lib/cups/backend/archive >/dev/null
#!/bin/sh
DEST=/srv/legacy2/print-spool-recovery/printed

if [ "$#" -eq 0 ]; then
    printf '%s\n' 'direct archive:/ "Electronic Archive Printer" "Electronic Archive Printer"'
    exit 0
fi

if [ "$#" -lt 5 ]; then
    printf '%s\n' "ERROR: archive backend requires job-id user title copies options [file]" >&2
    exit 1
fi

job_id=$1
title=$3
input_file=${6-}
safe_title=$(printf '%s' "$title" | tr -c 'A-Za-z0-9._-' '_' | sed 's/^_*//; s/_*$//' | cut -c1-80)
[ -n "$safe_title" ] || safe_title=untitled
final="$DEST/${job_id}-${safe_title}.raw"
tmp="$DEST/.${job_id}-$$.tmp"
umask 027
trap 'rm -f "$tmp"' 0 1 2 15

if [ -n "$input_file" ]; then
    cat "$input_file" > "$tmp" || exit 1
else
    cat > "$tmp" || exit 1
fi

if [ -f "$final" ]; then
    if cmp -s "$tmp" "$final"; then
        rm -f "$tmp"
        trap - 0 1 2 15
        exit 0
    fi
    printf '%s\n' "ERROR: archive output already exists with different bytes: $final" >&2
    exit 1
fi

mv "$tmp" "$final" || exit 1
trap - 0 1 2 15
exit 0
ANTRIEB_ARCHIVE_BACKEND
